mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening residential demand, which correlates with broader economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of months where HOUST rises month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a CPI reading above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) indicates a tightening cycle amid persistent inflation, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), economic weakness suppresses corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of months when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 115 (index 2017=100), it signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of months when INDPRO > 115, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI reading (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% (annualized), it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as valuations become stretched, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of months when GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.
